concepts.def: Class is template; object is instance with state and behaviour; Simula 1967 introduced OOP concepts.
Bundling data and methods; restricting direct access via private fields and public getters/setters.
Subclass inherits attributes and methods from superclass; allows code reuse and is-a relationships.
One interface, many implementations; method overriding and overloading; runtime dispatch.
Cannot be instantiated; declares interface and may include partial implementation; concrete subclasses required.
Boxes show class name, attributes, methods; arrows show inheritance and association (OMG standard 1997).

walkthroughs.body_html:
Object Oriented Programming — a core area of Computer Science.

Working through it builds the schema you need: the key terms, how they connect, and how to use them together.

Object Oriented Programming brings together several ideas you need to use as a set, not in isolation.

Lock in the vocabulary first, then practise pulling the ideas together to answer real questions.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Object Oriented Programming.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.
